about: The characters Font Check's lists and tooltips show, for checks/train/language_font.py: hexadecimal code points and ranges. names: the languages' names and autonyms and the headings (always shown); other_names: Glottolog's other names (a tooltip shows the one a search found); orthographies: base, auxiliary, and mark characters; sets: the character sets' and the scripts' own and shared characters, but those of a Unicode block of more than 1100 characters, of a Han repertoire of more than 25000, and of a script of more than 12000 (left_out names them).
